visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a wood-paneled elevator, a woman wearing a white lace-style cardigan and a graphic t-shirt holds a smartphone to a mirror, filming a selfie. Beside her, a man in a blue button-down shirt over a white t-shirt and ripped jeans looks at her. They both have neutral expressions initially. (2) The man and woman turn their heads toward each other and lean in slowly, pouting their lips as if preparing to kiss. The woman's eyes are partially closed, and she maintains her grip on the phone to capture the moment in the mirror. (3) Just before their lips touch, they both pull their upper bodies back while thrusting their stomachs forward until their midsections collide. The man places his hands behind his back. The woman begins to smile and laugh while maintaining the camera angle. (4) The couple continues to rhythmically bump their stomachs together in a repetitive, dance-like motion. The woman is laughing heartily with her mouth open. The elevator doors behind them slide open, revealing a hallway with boxes and a lit chandelier.
